inputBoundary: One caller-measured finite nonnegative consecutive dwell duration in minutes for an already-constructed place visit; the source wording 'in a row' is a precondition on that supplied duration.
outputBoundary: Retain the already-constructed place only when consecutive dwell is strictly greater than 15 minutes; equality is excluded by the source wording 'more than 15 minutes'.
limitations: The source does not disclose sampling cadence, gap tolerance, missing-fix handling, or how consecutive dwell is accumulated, so this binding does not reconstruct dwell from GPS samples.
This binding does not parse GPS records, calculate point distances, group points into places, choose clustering linkage or transitivity, or calculate a center of mass.
The source does not disclose sub-minute measurement precision, rounding, or tolerance around 15 minutes; none is inferred.
No exact study feature code or participant rows were released, so this proves the disclosed gate only and is not an end-to-end place-feature reproduction.
